root_cause_hypotheses.claim: Only a small fraction of injected parcels produce strict physical impacts, so parent-face spatial mass estimates have high Monte Carlo variance.
root_cause_hypotheses.test: same physical inputs, increase hit-support diagnostics and compare hit-parcel rate, impact count, active-face count, ESS, target-mass CV and active-face JS
root_cause_hypotheses.falsifier: stable active-face JS at low hit support or a strong improvement after changing only estimator resolution

root_cause_hypotheses.claim: CFD wall samples and the analytic Mansouri reference are not in a consistent coordinate, unit, topology or normal-angle convention.
root_cause_hypotheses.test: independent transform, unit, nearest-face and normal-angle audit before any new physical scoring
root_cause_hypotheses.falsifier: same-face mapping, acceptable distances and nonnegative spatial agreement under a frozen convention

root_cause_hypotheses.claim: Adaptive substeps, interpolation and integrator settings alter trajectories or create excessive near-miss work.
root_cause_hypotheses.test: fixed seed and injection replay across dt, strict_max_substep, interpolation and integrator levels
root_cause_hypotheses.falsifier: byte-identical hit arrays and stable termination/impact summaries across all tested resolutions

root_cause_hypotheses.claim: Triangle collision IDs and parent-face IDs are deterministic but may map impacts to an unintended face or suppress valid re-impacts.
root_cause_hypotheses.test: replay accepted trajectories through intersection, parent-face and collision-triangle mapping with face-ID and normal diagnostics
root_cause_hypotheses.falsifier: one-to-one intended mapping and no material change when mapping implementation is independently replayed

root_cause_hypotheses.claim: The v4 kernel and v5 18-aggregate map hide or redistribute parent-face variance rather than solve it.
root_cause_hypotheses.test: report raw parent-face, active-face, kernel and aggregate metrics at fixed input and multiple declared resolutions
root_cause_hypotheses.falsifier: parent-face or declared physical-resolution JS <= 0.05 without relying on coarse aggregation

experiment_layers.objective: Prove that immutable artifacts, summaries and NPZ arrays describe the same run.

experiment_layers.design: same seed, same topology, same native SI field, same transform, same code hashes, two fresh remote workspaces

experiment_layers.objective: Measure whether injection and PSD sampling create the instability.
experiment_layers.design: fixed tracking settings; compare number_random_v1 and mass_stratified_v1, then fixed radial strata versus random radial injection using registered random streams

experiment_layers.objective: Measure trajectory sensitivity and runtime overhead.
experiment_layers.design: fixed parcel samples; one factor at a time over dt, strict_max_substep, cfd interpolation and particle integrator

experiment_layers.objective: Verify that accepted impacts land on the intended parent faces.
experiment_layers.design: replay recorded segments; compare collision triangle, parent face, normal orientation, hit time and suppression state

experiment_layers.objective: Find the finest declared resolution that is numerically stable without false confidence from coarse bins.
experiment_layers.design: fixed hit arrays; raw parent-face, v4 kernel and v5 aggregate at 4096/8192/16384/32768 face budgets

experiment_layers.objective: Resolve the negative CFD-versus-Mansouri spatial agreement before physical accuracy claims.
experiment_layers.design: independently verify m/mm conversion, local/global row-vector convention, wall sample registration, UMean time semantics, collision-pre velocity and normal-angle formula

do_not_launch_high_n_confirmation_until: data audit has no error-level findings
same-seed replay is deterministic or nondeterminism is explicitly localized
physical configuration and implementation hashes are homogeneous
runtime estimate is below the remote timeout budget

convergence_gate.minimum_hit_support: pre-registered and reported; parcel count alone is insufficient

known_performance_risk.impact: a 20k seed can be terminated before completion under the default guard
known_performance_risk.repair: preflight runtime from smoke benchmark and set a registered remote timeout per experiment; never disable timeout or disk guard
